Ladakh Bans Chemical Fertilisers for Organic Farming Push

Ladakh has banned the use and sale of chemical fertilisers as part of a plan to become India's largest organic farming region. The Lieutenant Governor ordered the prohibition, aiming to accelerate the transition. This move signifies a significant step towards sustainable agriculture in the Union Territory.
